resources.string: Ratings, diary and watchlist through your Letterboxd web session.
Reconnection required: your Letterboxd session expired. Paste fresh cookies.

Sign in to letterboxd.com in your browser, open the developer tools (Network tab), reload the page, select the request to letterboxd.com and copy the whole “Cookie” request header. A Cookie-Editor JSON export or a cookies.txt file also works. It must include letterboxd.user.CURRENT, and ideally com.xk72.webparts.csrf and cf_clearance.
Paste the exact User-Agent of the browser the cookies come from (same request headers, or type navigator.userAgent in the console). Cloudflare ties cf_clearance to it.
Signing out only forgets the cookies in Nuvio. Your browser stays signed in.
Session: not signed in, the cookies are invalid or expired
Write access: blocked by Cloudflare. Add a fresh cf_clearance cookie and your browser’s exact User-Agent.
No CSRF token found: writes will fail.
No cf_clearance cookie: add it (with your browser’s exact User-Agent) to get past Cloudflare.
cf_clearance is present but no User-Agent is set: paste your browser’s User-Agent.
Cookies are stored in the macOS Keychain.
Cookies are encrypted with Windows DPAPI (current user).
Cookies are stored in the Secret Service keyring (secret-tool).
Cookies are stored in a file readable only by your user account (no system keyring available).
No valid Letterboxd cookie found in the pasted text.
Letterboxd session expired or invalid. Paste fresh cookies.
Blocked by Cloudflare. Refresh cf_clearance and check the User-Agent.
Too many requests to Letterboxd. Try again later.
Could not store the cookies securely.
